# Asio 1.38.2 (standalone)

Vendored, unmodified: `include/asio.hpp`, `include/asio/` and `LICENSE_1_0.txt` from
<https://github.com/chriskohlhoff/asio/archive/refs/tags/asio-1-38-2.tar.gz>
(SHA-256 `9f2648fa483e58a6bf848d970ee0ea650ca19ed7769dfa520ed4f7b8d27af1db`).

Boost Software License 1.0. Header-only use (`ASIO_STANDALONE`); included as a system path so its
headers are exempt from Osplay's warning flags, formatting and linting.
